findings.citationQuote: No liquid-fill or serum production line currently installed.
findings.reasoning: The manufacturing capability section explicitly states the facility produces pressed-powder compacts, solid stick formats, and cream-to-powder hybrids, and has no liquid-fill or serum production line installed, with liquid-line investment only planned for 2027. This directly indicates the supplier lacks documented experience producing liquid/serum skincare formulations and instead manufactures solid/powder cosmetics only.
